text: Any fool can write code that a computer can understand Good programmers write code that humans can understand

First solve the problem Then write the code If you spend too long on the second step you skipped the first
Programming is not about typing it is about thinking The keyboard is just the tool to express what you solved
Simplicity is prerequisite for reliability If you cannot explain it simply you do not understand it well enough
The most dangerous phrase in any language is we have always done it this way Question everything from the start
Talk is cheap Show me the code Make sure that code is clean fast and does exactly what it needs to do
Code is like humor When you have to explain it then it is bad Write code so clear that it reads like prose
The function of good software is to make the complex appear simple The user should never have to think twice
Before software can be reusable it first has to be usable Focus on making it work beautifully for one case
In a world obsessed with adding more features the real skill is knowing what to leave out Restraint is power
The computer was born to solve problems that did not exist before Now it solves problems we never knew we had
Measuring programming progress by lines of code is like measuring aircraft building progress by weight

Computer science is not the art of geniuses but many people doing things that build upon each other every day

Thunder rolled across the darkening sky as the train pulled away from the station leaving silence and rain
He walked through the market where vendors shouted prices for fresh bread while children chased birds

Between the mountains and the sea was a valley where the wind carried the scent of pine trees and salt water
Maps had been drawn a thousand times but the territory itself remained unchanged indifferent to the names
Somewhere between midnight and dawn the city goes quiet and the streets belong to the cats and streetlights
I do not fear computers I fear the lack of them A world without tools cannot solve its greatest challenges
Two things are infinite the universe and human nature And I am not completely sure about the universe
In the middle of difficulty lies opportunity The obstacle is not something to avoid but something to master
The nitrogen in our DNA the calcium in our teeth and the iron in our blood were made inside collapsing stars
We are all connected by the global network like neurons in a giant brain The goal is to use it wisely
Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic and magic was once just a bold idea
The biggest innovations of this century will happen at the intersection of biology and computing power
Stay hungry stay foolish Your time is limited so do not waste it living someone else dream Follow your path
The internet is becoming the town square for the global village where every single connection matters
